description: Provision a Google Cloud Logging LoggingLogView via Config Connector. Fields mirror the logging.cnrm.cloud.google.com/v1beta1 LoggingLogView spec.

billingAccountRef.description: Immutable. The BillingAccount that this resource belongs to. Only one of [billingAccountRef, folderRef, organizationRef, projectRef] may be specified. Set exactly one of `external` (the resource's GCP URI or ID) or `name` (plus optional `namespace`) referencing another Config Connector resource in the cluster.

external.description: The 'name' field of a billing account, when not managed by Config Connector.

bucketRef.description: Immutable. Set exactly one of `external` (the resource's GCP URI or ID) or `name` (plus optional `namespace`) referencing another Config Connector resource in the cluster.

external.description: A reference to an externally managed LoggingLogBucket resource. Should be in the format "projects/{{projectID}}/locations/{{location}}/buckets/{{bucketID}}".

kind.description: The kind of the LoggingLogBucket resource.

name.description: The name of a LoggingLogBucket resource.

namespace.description: The namespace of a LoggingLogBucket resource.

filter.description: Filter that restricts which log entries in a bucket are visible in this view. Filters are restricted to be a logical AND of ==/!= of any of the following: - originating project/folder/organization/billing account. - resource type - log id For example: SOURCE("projects/myproject") AND resource.type = "gce_instance" AND LOG_ID("stdout")

folderRef.description: Immutable. The Folder that this resource belongs to. Only one of [billingAccountRef, folderRef, organizationRef, projectRef] may be specified. Set exactly one of `external` (the resource's GCP URI or ID) or `name` (plus optional `namespace`) referencing another Config Connector resource in the cluster.

external.description: The 'name' field of a folder, when not managed by Config Connector. The recommended format is "folders/{folderID}".

location.description: Immutable. The location of the resource. The supported locations are: global, us-central1, us-east1, us-west1, asia-east1, europe-west1.

organizationRef.description: Immutable. The Organization that this resource belongs to. Only one of [billingAccountRef, folderRef, organizationRef, projectRef] may be specified. Set exactly one of `external` (the resource's GCP URI or ID) or `name` (plus optional `namespace`) referencing another Config Connector resource in the cluster.

external.description: The 'name' field of an organization, when not managed by Config Connector.

projectId.description: GCP project ID for this resource. Rendered as the cnrm.cloud.google.com/project-id annotation. Leave empty to inherit the project from the namespace (Config Connector falls back to the namespace's project-id annotation, then to the namespace name). Leave empty when this resource's spec already carries a projectRef.
projectId.title: GCP project ID

projectRef.description: Immutable. The Project that this resource belongs to. Only one of [billingAccountRef, folderRef, organizationRef, projectRef] may be specified. Set exactly one of `external` (the resource's GCP URI or ID) or `name` (plus optional `namespace`) referencing another Config Connector resource in the cluster.

external.description: The `projectID` field of a project, when not managed by Config Connector.

resourceID.description: Immutable. Optional. The name of the resource. Used for creation and acquisition. When unset, the value of `metadata.name` is used as the default.

title: GCP Logging LoggingLogView
